current.text: Josh projects Risacher as the 10th man in the Dallas rotation, maybe lower.
His minutes kept dropping during last season.
Dallas has too many wings and forwards who expect minutes, so frontcourt minutes are crowded.
Dusty May is the new Dallas head coach, so the rotation is not settled.

durable.text: Risacher is a low-usage forward. He hits threes, scores at a mediocre level and does little else.
He rarely passes and gets under four rebounds a game.
His free throw shooting is weak.
His game is similar to Harrison Barnes.

note: Risacher should not be drafted in our league. Yahoo ranks him 273 and ESPN 218, both sites value him at 0 USD, and only 144 players get drafted. He has no strong category and no punt fit: his only plus is few turnovers, and threes are just average (1.5 per game). Early in the season, check whether Dusty May gives him more than the 10th-man minutes Josh projects. Otherwise leave him on waivers.
